elections.quote:
You haven't heard a word from me since about Platner even though he still won't shut up :)

And I've said: I want AES to win.

Criticizing the left to make them better strategists isn't the same as just bitching out their policies, but people here have a hard time seeing that.

Unlike, say, Bill, I will sometimes rail at the yoots for being silly, but my biggest beef is always "the left politician and the Oberlin dandy are going to cost you winnable elections."

All I care about is strategery.

Respectfully, getting more Democrats elected is the best thing one can do for the safety of trans people. Far too many people stayed home because they felt Harris didn’t push back on Israeli government support. How did that work out for the Palestinians?
You need to separate out what will help Dems win from what should they do if they win. Tom's point is that arguing with Republicans about bathrooms *during a campaign* is fighting on their terms.
Republicans WANT to be talking about bathrooms, because if they are, they're not talking about affordability or Trump's shitshow. Don't make their life easier for them.

Does anyone really think that if these Democrats win, any of that will happen?

Or is the idea to just tank Democrats and "sharpen the contradictions?"
They took over by winning elections. I know this is going to sound crazy, but - and just hear me out - the way to stop them is for Democrats to win elections
